summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release disclosing weekly progress under its share buyback program announced 30 October 2025. The Belgian 3D printing company bought 32,161 shares on Nasdaq from 14-18 September 2026 at an average price of EUR 6.63 per share, totaling EUR 213,270, under a discretionary mandate capped at EUR 30 million. Since inception on 26 January 2026, 1,355,221 shares (2.3% of shares outstanding) were repurchased for EUR 6,958,976. The program is ongoing; watch for completion pace against the EUR 30 million authorization and any EPS or liquidity effect.
